name: Screen
subtitle: The Work Behind Repair
fact: In its 2020 Apple Watch Series 6 teardown, iFixit found that replacing the screen was difficult but possible. Its tiny tri-point screws are easy to remove but hard to keep track of.
source: iFixit (2020), Apple Watch Series 6 Teardown, Final Thoughts

name: Circuit Board
subtitle: Emissions Before Use
fact: Apple's 2020 report estimates a lifetime carbon footprint of 36 kg CO₂e for the US configuration of the Apple Watch Series 6 with a 44 mm aluminium case and Sport Band. Production accounts for 78% of that total.
source: Apple (2020), Apple Watch Series 6 Product Environmental Report

name: Battery
subtitle: A Limited Lifetime
fact: The battery is designed to keep up to 80% of its original capacity after 1,000 complete charge cycles. Its lifespan varies with use and device settings.

name: Case
subtitle: What Remains After Disposal
fact: The Global E-waste Monitor 2024 reports that the world generated 62 million tonnes of electronic waste in 2022. Only 22.3% by mass was documented as formally collected and recycled.
source: ITU and UNITAR (2024), The Global E-waste Monitor 2024
